page_title: JUV 2-1 ROM | Juventus v AS Roma 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+4' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
90+3' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' A substitution has been made. Kenan Yildiz goes off and Fabio Miretti (Juventus) comes on.
89' Luciano Spalletti prepares a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Filip Kostic (Juventus).
87' Weston McKennie (Juventus) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes.
82' Substitution. Jonathan David (Juventus) on for Lois Openda.
80' OFF THE POST! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
79' The percentage of ball possession is – 43:57.

76' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Michele Di Gregorio anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
75' 2 - 1 Goal 2:1! Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
73' Substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) in, Leon Bailey out.
73' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
70' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Weston McKennie sprays a pass out to Lois Openda (Juventus), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.

70' Weston McKennie (Juventus) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mile Svilar, who pulls off a comfortable save!

67' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
67' The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
65' Manu Kone (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
65' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
61' Luciano Spalletti is forced to make a change. Bremer (Juventus) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Daniele Rugani.
61' Edon Zhegrova comes onto the pitch after Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
58' The foul by Manu Kone (AS Roma) was seen by Simone Sozza who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
56' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) replacing Matias Soule.
56' It will be a substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) is ready to enter the pitch as Paulo Dybala walks off.
55' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
54' No change in the score after an effort on goal by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) from a rebound. Good save by the goalkeeper.
53' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Mile Svilar.
53' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leon Bailey (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch so that Lorenzo Pellegrini can be given a rest.

51' A sweet pass inside the box gives Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
49' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

44' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrea Cambiaso plays in Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 1:0.
44' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.
43' Lois Openda (Juventus) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
43' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Mile Svilar is alert and denies him.
41' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
39' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
38' That's unlucky! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
37' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and it's Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
34' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

32' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
32' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
31' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
30' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Juventus will take a throw-in.
28' Lois Openda (Juventus) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
24' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
23' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
21' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Matias Soule (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
20' AS Roma players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
19' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
18' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' Looks like Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
14' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) commits a foul and Simone Sozza immediately signals a free kick.
11' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Michele Di Gregorio, who makes a comfortable save.
8' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

7' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) slammed the ball from a mid-range free kick towards the net! He unleashed a low shot that went to the left, exactly where the keeper was standing. Such an easy save for him.
7' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) trips an opposition player and Simone Sozza signals a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Juventus.
6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lloyd Kelly (Juventus). The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
4' The ball is cleared after Weston McKennie (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
